nodes.thesis: The shipped floating surfaces already settle the palette, geometry and motion; the app window does not use any of it.
The app window inherits Spark's palette, geometry and motion but never its material, and settings regroup around the object being configured rather than the feature that first needed it.
nodes.selection_basis: D1 owner-directed on 2026-08-25 (C, overriding the recommended B); D2-D5 taken at their recommended values after going unanswered, reversible by document edit because nothing is implemented in code

variants.thesis: One window; settings nest as a sidebar section.
Content window plus a native preferences window, each with a short sidebar.
A per-context Mode becomes the primary object and absorbs most per-feature settings.

cost_correction.claim_retracted: C requires a new persisted object and is not a one-release change
cost_correction.evidence: DictationStyleGroup is {id,name,styleID,matchers[]}; DictationStyleMatcher is {kind:bundle_id|hostname,pattern}; DictationStyleResolver.resolve already ships the full precedence ladder with normalisation, collision detection, quarantine and a LegacyProjection; WritingStylesView is already the routing editor
cost_correction.revised: C is a payload widening on an existing persisted object plus promotion of an existing editor from a modal sheet to the sidebar

ia_correction.was: Library listed Styles and Prompts as separate items
ia_correction.is: WritingStylesView is routing, TranscriptCleanupPromptsManagerView is prompt bodies; under C the routing half becomes Modes. Library is Dictionary, Prompts, Templates

decisions.question: Does the user-selectable accent survive?
decisions.taken: option 2 - presets survive, scoped to selection and highlight only; semantic signals stay coral

decisions.question: Inter or SF Pro in the app window?
decisions.taken: option 1 - Inter, SF Pro left on AppKit-drawn system controls

decisions.question: Does the light appearance go warm?
decisions.taken: option 1 - warm paper in both appearances

decisions.question: How far does the credentials registry go in v1?
decisions.taken: option 1 - full registry, conditional on a tolerant config migration; falls back to option 2 only after asking the owner
decisions.note: C strengthens this: a Mode references a provider assignment and never holds a credential

decisions.question: Under C, where do the remaining global settings live?
decisions.taken: option 2 - split, global settings in a Cmd-comma preferences window
decisions.note: genuinely close; option 1 (one window) is viable because C shrinks global settings

never_holds: credentials - references an AI Providers assignment
precedence: explicitly invoked Mode - single dictation, non-persisting (added by C)
best matching Mode by hostname (ships as group)
